title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates.
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition is a crucial aspect of the pregnancy process. Expectant mothers need to provide their bodies with adequate nutrients to ensure the healthy development of their baby. In this article, we will explore international pantry staples that are good for pregnancy, helping to build balanced and nutritious meals.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy
The following international pantry staples are excellent choices for expectant mothers:
- Oats: rich in fiber, supporting digestive health and providing energy for the body.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, supporting the development of the baby's bones and teeth.
- Lentils: rich in protein, fiber, and iron, supporting the baby's development and preventing anemia.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3 fatty acids, supporting the development of the baby's brain and eyes.
- Eggs: rich in protein, vitamins, and minerals, supporting the baby's development.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins and minerals, supporting the immune system and preventing infections.

## Building Balanced Meals for Pregnancy
To build balanced and nutritious meals, expectant mothers can combine these international pantry staples with traditional Vietnamese foods. For example:
- Breakfast: oats with Greek yogurt and fruit.
- Lunch: lentils with leafy greens and low-mercury salmon.
- Dinner: eggs with leafy greens and citrus.

## Food Safety Considerations
Expectant mothers should be mindful of food safety when preparing and consuming these international pantry staples. Some important considerations:
- Choose fresh and clean ingredients.
- Wash hands before preparing and consuming food.
- Cook food thoroughly before consumption.
- Avoid foods that may cause food poisoning or allergic reactions.

## Conclusion
Pregnancy nutrition is a vital aspect of the pregnancy process. Expectant mothers need to provide their bodies with adequate nutrients to ensure the healthy development of their baby. International pantry staples like oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus can help build balanced and nutritious meals. For more information on pregnancy nutrition and recipes, expectant mothers can visit [our website](/blog) or [sign up for premium](/premium) to receive guidance from nutrition experts.
